tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
USA Today is suing OpenAI over copyright concerns. Reported by The Verge: the publisher joins others taking legal action against the company.
Anthropic has expanded rules against abusive behavior toward Claude. Confirmed by The Verge: the company is strengthening its misuse policies.
India plans to release an AI regulation consultation paper next month. Confirmed by Exchange4Media: the effort will focus on safety and deepfakes.
The FTC is moving forward with its artificial intelligence safety investigation. Reported by Semafor: the agency is preparing its probe amid public disclosure.
Microsoft is facing bundling complaints over Copilot in Belgium. Reported by Global Competition Review: the country raised concerns about the productivity suite integration.
Free every hour.
